name: timeline_timestomp
description: Sequencing, and the anti-forensics aimed at it. A dropper is backdated to look like it has been on the host for over a year; a second file is left alone as the control. The claims: the collection builds a filesystem timeline at all, that timeline carries the planted files, and the backdating is detected — which is possible only because ctime cannot be set by any userspace API.

expect.id: the timeline records whether it was truncated
the timeline is in TSK body format, usable by mactime
the backdated dropper appears in the timeline
an untouched file also appears — the timeline is not a findings list
the backdating is FLAGGED as timestamp manipulation
the flagged file is the backdated one
the untouched control file is NOT flagged — the check discriminates
